**What you said**

Exactly, if you can. This is the important part.

**What it did with it**

Which detail did it get wrong — the day, the time, the number of people, your
name, your number?

**What you meant**

---

*Why this template exists:* the fixture corpus in `tests/fixtures/` is
append-only. Every reported misunderstanding becomes a new fixture in the same
commit as its fix, so the same sentence cannot break twice.
